tools.name: home_state
tools.description: Read the state of one Home Assistant entity, for example light.kitchen or sensor.living_room_temperature.

entity_id.description: The entity id, for example climate.hall

tools.name: home_light
tools.description: Turn a light on or off. Only the lights listed here can be changed.

tools.name: home_assist
tools.description: Ask Home Assistant's own voice assistant to do or answer something in plain words, for example 'turn off the porch light' or 'is the garage door open'. Use home_light or home_state when they fit.

text.description: What to say to Home Assistant
